alt: 老師和同學仔細指出紙橋模型各處的問題，學生聽著全面的建議。
scene_prompt: Use the figurative meaning of 體無完膚: a proposal is criticized and rebutted so thoroughly that no part remains unchallenged. At a modern student design review, a young inventor presents a cardboard bridge model and simple poster. A friendly teacher and two classmates carefully point out problems across different parts of the model—weak supports, a gap in the roadway, uneven load distribution—while the student listens thoughtfully, surprised but safe. Many small blank sticky notes and colored arrows mark flaws across the model, showing thorough critique without insulting the child. No injury or physical violence. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs, hands and pointing contact plausible, bridge model supported on table with sensible beam placements.
style_prompt: Create ONE child-friendly picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, muted natural colors. No text, logos or watermarks.
